up: Retrieve the distinct target names (pref_name from the target_dictionary table) for all assays where the assay organism is exactly 'Oryctolagus cuniculus'. Join the assays table with the target_dictionary table on the tid column. Do not apply any additional filters on target type, confidence score, or document metadata. Return only the distinct target names as the output.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT td.pref_name
FROM assays a
JOIN target_dictionary td ON a.tid = td.tid
WHERE a.assay_organism = 'Oryctolagus cuniculus'
